description:
Monitor websites, APIs, and services with 44 tools across 22 protocols (HTTP, TCP, DNS, SSL, gRPC, ICMP, and more).
   Manage monitors, alerts, incidents, status pages, heartbeats, and Telegram groups. Works in test mode with mock
  data — no account needed to try it out.
